why: An absent or junk stored palette falls back to something other than the default (issue #1058). Every payload a build before #1058 wrote has no `ownerPalette`, so every returning player who never opened the new control would start drawing in High contrast: a visible change to the shipped colours that nobody asked for, and the opposite of 'Classic is the default and a player who never opens Settings sees no change'.
killedBy: parseSettingsPayload: stored data loads a payload saved before the owner palette existed as Classic, keeping every sibling (issue #1058)
parseSettingsPayload: stored data defaults each field INDEPENDENTLY when its neighbour is junk
